name: Spinner
layerWhy: It says one thing, "working", and nothing about when it ends.
promise: Something is happening and its length is unknown.
expectation: A turning mark beside the work.
evidence: It is used only when neither the shape nor the length of what is coming is known, and it is read as its label.
behaviour: Turns steadily; under reduced motion it breathes instead.
context: Short waits of unknown length. A list that is loading uses skeletons; measurable work uses progress.
relationships: Its label says what is happening: "Checking the address".
accessibility: role="status" with a visually hidden label.
failures: Never hides a known shape or length.
dont: A spinner for a page whose layout is known.
